connector.name: Mymlh MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: OAuth-enabled MyMLH MCP server for accessing MyMLH data.
connector.summary: Hosted at mymlh-mcp.git.ci over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ci.git. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
